To build off the answer others have given:

Voat itself does not use tracking scripts in its ads, and they are almost all direct links. However, most companies will evaluate their own traffic, and decide if the ad was worth the cost. Other companies will look as their sales, especially if advertised site themselves don't have ads. Also probably worht mentioning that when looking at traffic, a business will usually look for unique page views (as in the total number of unique IP addresses that have visited).
